*Methods 4.2 'Transcriptome sequencing analysis', with the BioSample growth_protocol*

> Total RNA from the upper part of senescing ear leaves of maize cultivar B73 at 0, 14 and 21 DAS (Day After Silking) were extracted by using TRIzol reagent and submitted to Chinese National Human Genomic Center at Shanghai (CHGCS) for RNA sequencing. BioSample attributes for all three runs: growth_protocol 'Plants were cultivated at the experimental station of Fudan University'; collected_by 'Fudan University Institute of plant biology'; geo_loc_name 'China: Shanghai'; sample_type 'top area of ear leaf'.
